name: Codility
summary: Codility sells coding and skills tests for hiring teams. Its pricing page lists online plans from $800 a month or $4,800 a year, and quotes Enterprise. The online plans include plagiarism detection and proctoring with snapshots, and selected task types are scored automatically.

facts.text: Per the pricing page, coding tests can be set with AI use turned on or off for each task.

Plagiarism detection and proctoring with snapshots are listed on Codility's online and Enterprise plans, per the pricing page. Video proctoring and flagging of unauthorized apps are listed for Enterprise only.
Codility's pricing page says selected task types are scored against fixed rules, and that no AI or machine learning makes hiring decisions.
Pricing page: weighted scoring and premium analytics are listed for Enterprise only.

plans.name: Online
plans.notes: Listed from $800 a month, or from $4,800 a year. Plan limits were not recorded.
